turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Frank?
This is Mike, Frank's son. He's resting right now.
Thank you, Mike. You can answer for Frank today. I'm calling for the check-in about how Frank has been feeling since the last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yes, now is okay. I can answer for him.
I understood that now is a good time. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, now is a good time.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Sorry, I don't think he's had any of that. Would that be "never"?
That's okay. I understood that Frank has had no loose or watery bowel movements in the past 7 days. That would be "never." Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, he hasn't mentioned feeling sick to his stomach.
I understood that Frank has never felt sick to his stomach in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, he hasn't thrown up at all.
I understood that Frank has never thrown up in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
No, he hasn't had any fever, chills, or shaking.
I understood that Frank has had no fever, chills, or shaking in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, no fever, chills, or shaking.
In the past 7 days, how much shortness of breath have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
No, he hasn't had any shortness of breath, so none.
I understood that Frank has had no shortness of breath in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, none.
In the past 7 days, how much dizziness have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
He hasn't said anything about being dizzy, so I'd say none.
I understood that Frank has had no dizziness in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, none.
In the past 7 days, how much tiredness or lack of energy have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
He's been very tired, I'd say severe.
I understood that Frank's tiredness or lack of energy has been severe in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, severe. Rest doesn't really help his tiredness either.
Thank you. Does resting make the tiredness better?
No, resting doesn't really help his tiredness at all.
I understood that resting does not make Frank's tiredness better. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, resting doesn't help.
In the past 7 days, has Frank had a new skin rash?
No, he hasn't had any new skin rash.
I understood that Frank has had no new skin rash in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, no new rash.
Have you or your family noticed any new confusion, trouble finding words, or unusual sleepiness?
Yes, he's seemed confused since yesterday and he's mixing up his words.

Thank you for telling me. I'm asking the on-call nurse to call you right now. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No, there haven't been any changes to his medicines.
I understood that Frank has not started, stopped, or changed any medicines. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, no changes to his medicines.
Since Frank's last study visit, has he gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, he hasn't gone to the emergency room, urgent care, or any other doctor.
I understood that Frank has not gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, he hasn't seen anyone.
Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, that's everything. Thank you, I'll wait for the nurse's call.
Thank you, Frank. The nurse will call you very soon. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
